rules: One semantic action has one interactive writer.
One current training fact has one authoritative store.
Compatibility bridges delegate; they do not regain authority.
A derived projection or resolver cannot create a second persistence model.
Flow intent may extend the established app-owned axis_v60_state but cannot become Encounter fact authority.
Temporary Flow recording context may affect only the current recording handoff and may not mutate reusable Object truth.
Classic repeated-set facts remain v61-owned even when a Flow selects the Object.
Ordinary single/complete remain one-shot; ongoing Flow modes may reuse only the existing v82/v87 Active lifecycle.
Evolution Replay is presentation-only over existing Encounter truth and cannot become a writer/network/AI/media owner.
Replay-to-Evidence continuity is a transient presentation handoff; v815 remains the Evidence owner.
AXIS 8.24 tactile and AXIS 8.24.1 dock occlusion remain Production-sealed presentation-only capabilities.
AXIS 8.25 Set Lock factual boundary remains sealed while its fullscreen treatment remains superseded.
AXIS 8.25.1 Inline Set Morph is Production-sealed and reacts only after existing v87 completeSet truth.
AXIS 8.26 Active Continuity is Production-sealed and may coordinate only through existing factual owners.
AXIS 8.26.1 Active Rest State is Production-sealed and may adjust paused/rest presentation only; it does not own pause/resume, timer, Session, Encounter, Flow, persistence, network or AI truth.
Changing an owner requires explicit handoff, regression proof, and retirement of the previous writer.
